steps: packages/server/src/Authentication.ts: define `BearerResolverContribution { id: string; claims: (raw: string) => boolean; resolve: (credential) => Effect<Api.Principal, Api.Unauthenticated> }`, and `BearerCredentialResolvers` as an ADR-EA-012 aggregating registry (contributions appended by Layer, frozen at first read, ordered by dependency order then id).
The bearer handler asks each contribution in order via `claims`. The first match resolves; if none match, resolveSession runs. Resolution happens per request, as PostAuthResponseHook's does.
@awthaq/jwt contributes `{ id: "jwt", claims: three segments }` when acceptAsBearer is set; @awthaq/api-key (MAPS-003) contributes `{ id: "api-key", claims: startsWith(config.prefix) }`.

The exposure hygiene (MAPS-008) and the orDie concern (NHS-007) touch the same code.
